source.title: SBTi Progress Report 2024
source.snippet: In September 2023, we submitted our targets to SBTi for validation and in May 2024, our targets were approved for scope 1, 2 and 3 near-term targets for 2030, absolute long-term targets and a Net-zero target for 2050. All our targets are within the 1,5C limit to global warming.
